test.fill_query: INSERT INTO promql_group_left_dynamic_filter_ts (metric_name, tags, samples) SELECT 'requests', map('instance', toString(number), 'dc', toString(number % 2)), arrayMap(step -> (toDateTime64(100 + step * 10, 3), (sipHash64(number, step) % 1000000) / 1000), range(300)) FROM numbers_mt(100) UNION ALL SELECT 'target_info', map('dc', toString(number), 'env', toString(number % 3)), arrayMap(step -> (toDateTime64(100 + step * 10, 3), 1), range(300)) FROM numbers_mt(50000)
test.query: SELECT * FROM prometheusQueryRange('promql_group_left_dynamic_filter_ts', 'requests * on (dc) group_left (env) target_info', 100, 3090, 10) FORMAT Null
SELECT * FROM prometheusQueryRange('promql_group_left_dynamic_filter_ts', 'requests * on (dc) group_left (env) (target_info offset 10s)', 100, 3090, 10) FORMAT Null
